description: GaitX: an output expander reporting where a Phi or Spike play head has reached; it goes to the right of that module

outputs.text: A trigger each time the play head passes the beginning or the end of the buffer
The position of the play head within the current step, as a rising voltage
A voltage that follows which step the play head is on, scaled as the menu chooses

notes: this module is placed to the right of the Phi or Spike module it reports on, or beside another connected output expander on that side
menu: Step output voltage: 1/16th per step, Rescaled 0-10V to length, 1/Length per step — chooses how the current step is turned into a voltage
